title: Using the playground
description: Run a greeting, then query a small herd using variables and request context.

steps.title: Run and edit
steps.description: Run English greeting, then French greeting. Change the name in Variables and run again. Change Hello in lib/greeting.ts to Welcome to edit the resolver behavior.

steps.title: Explore a schema
steps.description: Run Tall giraffes, then All giraffes. Change minimumHeight in Variables to filter the herd. Open schema.graphql to inspect the field and argument types.
